lesson.beat.cover.body2: First, one whole life in half a minute. Then a hike, and a girl with two paths.
lesson.beat.life.heading: Many paths. Here’s one.
lesson.beat.life.step2: His parents sign him up for choir.
lesson.beat.life.step4: He starts a band with two friends.
lesson.beat.life.step5: The band writes its own song.
lesson.beat.life.step6: A radio DJ plays it. Luck!
lesson.beat.life.step7: A record label signs the band.
lesson.beat.life.step8: Fame. Late nights. Money spent fast.
lesson.beat.life.step9: The band splits. The money’s gone.
lesson.beat.life.step10: He asks for help. Teaches guitar.
lesson.beat.life.step11: New songs. Many paths still ahead.
lesson.beat.life.alt: One life route grows across the map from the Beginning, point by point, from birth to age thirty. It rises after a lucky radio play and a record deal, drops when the band splits and the money is gone, and climbs again after Sam asks for help and starts teaching.
lesson.beat.life.a.step8: Fame. Late nights, bad habits, money gone.
lesson.beat.life.a.step9: The band splits. He loses his flat.
lesson.beat.life.a.step10: A friend takes him in. He asks for help.
lesson.beat.life.a.step11: He teaches guitar. New songs. Many paths ahead.
lesson.beat.life.a.alt: One life route grows across the map from the Beginning, point by point, from birth to age thirty. It rises after a lucky radio play and a record deal, drops when the band splits and he loses his flat, and climbs again after a friend takes him in and he asks for help.
lesson.beat.adds.heading: Choices add up.
lesson.beat.adds.body1: Choir led to guitar, guitar to a band, the band to a song. Luck lifted Sam’s path. A hard year pushed it down. Not everything was his to choose. Now let’s look at choices over just a few days.
lesson.beat.adds.alt: Sam’s whole route, with three labels: His choice on the guitar point, Luck on the radio point, Not his choice where the band splits.
